messages:
maria: quick copy + layout pass needed for the 'Create snapshot' CTA inside the Stop Instance modal. product wants to nudge snapshots but not make them feel like a forced step. attached Figma frame.
choi: current layout puts 'Create snapshot' after the destructive action which feels backwards. users should see the safe alternative first.
anika: agree. also the inline text currently reads 'Create snapshot (recommended)' which is redundant. small nit: recommended pattern we use elsewhere is 'Create snapshot to preserve state' in the body and a simple button label 'Create snapshot'.
maria: good call. product wants the primary destructive button still visually prominent (red) but not focused. devs: can we reorder buttons: Cancel | Create snapshot | Stop instance (red)?
dev-bot: technically straightforward. will ensure tabindex order matches visual order and no autofocus on red button.
a11y-bot: accessibility: set initial focus to Cancel, tie the Stop button to aria-describedby referencing the explanatory paragraph, and use aria-live for snapshot creation status. also ensure link text for docs is descriptive.
product-bot: analytics: fire event modal.stop.suggestion_shown and modal.stop.snapshot_clicked. please add i18n keys modal.stop.snapshot_cta and modal.stop.snapshot_body.
choi: copy draft suggestion: header 'Stop instance' body 'Stopping this instance cancels running jobs, detaches volumes (data is kept), and stops compute billing. Create a snapshot to save session state before stopping.' buttons: Cancel | Create snapshot | Stop instance (aria-label: 'Stop instance and cancel running jobs').
anika: tiny wording tweak: change 'detaches volumes (data is kept)' -> 'detaches attached volumes — your data remains unless you delete it'. clearer.
maria: final dev-ready snippet: 

{"header":"Stop instance","body_id":"stop-desc","body":"Stopping this instance cancels running jobs, detaches attached volumes — your data remains unless you delete it, and stops compute billing. Create a snapshot to save session state before stopping.","buttons":["Cancel","Create snapshot","Stop instance"]} 

(not a title, just pasteable JSON for devs).
dev-bot: will add tests for focus order, aria-describedby present, and snapshot button aria-labels.
a11y-bot: one more: ensure the 'Create snapshot' button is not a link but a real button so it's reachable to keyboard and exposure to assistive tech is consistent.
maria: thanks everyone. i'll update Figma and add copy to the PR. will loop back after staging a11y checks. :white_check_mark:
